`storybook` styles a Quarto presentation as a storybook: a laid-out title slide, a logo, and a footer, with the warmth that suits a talk meant to be told rather than presented.

[See a deck built by this site](preview.html).

![](preview.html){.embed-art loading="lazy" title="A deck in the storybook theme" style="--atelier-embed-art-ratio: 1.78;"}

## Starting a presentation

```bash
quarto use template {{< var extension.reference >}}
```

::: {.btn-group role="group" aria-label="Quarto Wizard installer options"}

[Visual Studio Code](vscode://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/use?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Use {{< var extension.reference >}} in Visual Studio Code using the Quarto Wizard extension."}
[Positron](positron://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/use?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Use {{< var extension.reference >}} in Positron using the Quarto Wizard extension."}
[VSCodium](vscodium://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/use?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Use {{< var extension.reference >}} in VSCodium using the Quarto Wizard extension."}

:::

## Adding it to a presentation you already have

```bash
quarto add {{< var extension.reference >}}
```

This will install the extension under the `_extensions` subdirectory.
If you are using version control, you will want to check in this directory.

::: {.btn-group role="group" aria-label="Quarto Wizard installer options"}

[Visual Studio Code](vscode://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in Visual Studio Code using the Quarto Wizard extension."}

## Quick start

```yaml
format: storybook-revealjs
```

The theme takes the title, subtitle, author, institute, and date from the front matter and lays out the title slide from them.

See the [Reference](reference.qmd) for what it styles, and the [Examples](examples.qmd) for the source behind the deck.

## Where it works

RevealJS.
